note: Cinematic budget: 50 s in total (plan limit 70 s; standards limit 90 s, each shot <= 25 s). Every shot is skippable (button + Esc), captioned, has a text description, and becomes a still frame with reduced motion. Camera coordinates are metres in each location's local space. Captions may use {phrases} (number of phrasebook entries).

captions: You've just arrived in Harbour City. Everyone here speaks English.
shots.description: The camera moves slowly through a large station hall with a glass roof. A departures board lists trains to Seaview, Northgate and the airport.

captions: Today you have four things to do: get a ticket, order lunch, visit a pharmacy, and check in at your hostel.
shots.description: The camera settles at a blue help desk. A staff member stands behind it. Next to it, a red ticket machine shows an error message.

captions: Task 1: the ticket machine won't take your card. The help desk is open.
shots.description: The camera moves past the ticket machine to the help desk, where Sam is waiting.

captions: Task 2: lunch at the Harbour Café. Read the menu board before you order.
shots.description: The camera arrives at a café counter with a cake display and a large menu board. Priya is behind the counter.

captions: Task 3: the pharmacy. This is language practice only, not medical advice.
shots.description: The camera arrives at a pharmacy counter with shelves of plain boxes and a green sign. Mr Okafor is behind the counter.

captions: Task 4: check in at Harbour Hostel. You booked a private room for three nights.
shots.description: The camera arrives at a hostel reception desk in a bright lobby. Leo is behind the desk.

captions: Evening in Harbour City. You did all four tasks in English. Your phrasebook now has {phrases} phrases to review.
shots.description: The lobby lights are lower now. The camera slowly moves back from the reception desk.
